name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedGGH15.overcomplete_cut
title: Open: the overcomplete cut lemma of the masked GGH15 WE candidate (PR #55)
statement: Let 1 <= L <= h with the sub-CNF of the clauses inside the first L variables unsatisfiable and 2^(L-1) > dR + w n' (overcomplete). In the cut hybrid of PR #55 (CPRF block stripped; levels 1..L with secrets diag(R_i, M_{i,b} (x) S'_{i,b}); at level L the first-L clause blocks have targets (M_{L,b})_kk U_{b,k} + E with U uniform, the other blocks honest targets; published W = (r_0 | -(j_C (x) s'_0)) A_0 and D_1..D_L), the real view and the view with every level-L target replaced by an independent uniform matrix satisfy: under decision LWE with k bits at parameters pL in the CVW18 regime, every machine has 2^k * gain <= (2^L * hopLoss(L, rows))^2 * (cost + simCost).
